description: Cross-validated from App Store rankings, WeChat mini-program data, viral case studies, Sensor Tower reports
validation: Multiple data sources cross-checked: QuestMobile + App Store rankings + viral case studies + consumer surveys

viral_consumer_success_cases.name: 死了么 (Demumu)
viral_consumer_success_cases.peak: Apple App Store #1 paid for 4 consecutive days
viral_consumer_success_cases.viral_mechanic: controversial name + daily checkin + emergency contact notification
viral_consumer_success_cases.key_insight: solves real fear (dying alone unnoticed). dead simple UX. name IS the marketing.

viral_consumer_success_cases.name: 小猫补光灯
viral_consumer_success_cases.peak: Apple App Store #1 paid on launch day
viral_consumer_success_cases.viral_mechanic: girlfriend needed photo lighting → built in 1 hour → posted on social media
viral_consumer_success_cases.key_insight: solves a specific micro-problem for a specific person. instant value. no explanation needed.

viral_consumer_success_cases.name: Pingo AI
viral_consumer_success_cases.viral_mechanic: TikTok organic. 'Roast mode' video got 52M views. Not designed for virality — it happened naturally.
viral_consumer_success_cases.key_insight: solves real fear (speaking foreign language). has personality. zero ad spend. all organic.

what_sells: Freemium with viral free tier → subscription upsell
Emotional/entertainment value (潮玩, 短视频, 零食)
Tools that solve ONE specific problem instantly
Social sharing baked into the product experience
what_doesnt_sell: High-priced subscriptions without free tier proof

viral_triggers: 实用价值展示 (如'1小时做出了这个')
社交货币 (如'我也测了，结果...')
